content.text:
Klippy is running now. It was failing because `run-klippy.ps1` ran a bare `dotnet build` first, which builds the whole solution. Klippy.Android fails on this machine because Android SDK API 36 isn't installed, so the script stopped before it ever got to `dotnet run`.

I changed the script to `dotnet run --project ./Klippy.Desktop/Klippy.Desktop.csproj`, which builds only the desktop app and what it depends on. Then I relaunched through the script, and the Klippy window is up.

The change is committed on this branch (1f8645f) but not pushed. The startup hook reported another agent (sdk-ts @ Atlantic1) active on issue #53; this commit only touches `run-klippy.ps1`.
